_comment: English overrides for phases.content.ts / diagnostics.content.ts. EMPTY ON PURPOSE FOR NOW: the content translation is sequenced after the output-analyser work lands in those two files, so this file ships as the wired-up, verified mechanism and nothing else. Shape (see content-i18n.ts, which is the type-level source of truth): { "phases": { "<phase.id>": { "title", "why", "stopGate", "paste": { "<index>": { "label" } }, "checks": { "<check.id>": { "label", "failFix": { "<index>": { "when", "note" } } } } } }, "symptoms": { "<symptom.id>": { "seen", "causes": { "<index>": { "tell", "cause", "note" } } } }, "assertions": { "<check.id>": { "fallback", "rules": { "<index>": { "why" } } } } }. There is deliberately NO key for command, expect, assert, script, probe or fix -- those must stay byte-identical in every locale, and the absence of a key is what makes that true rather than a rule someone has to remember. scripts/check-guided-i18n.mjs enforces the rest.
